Definition: properly, a thicket of men, i.e. a crowd
BiblicalUsage: çâk — a thicket of men, a crowd — turns up in its single occurrence in Psalms. It is a small word, and it stays in its own lane.
TheologicalSignificance: To me, çâk is a small window into how precisely God speaks.
